description: The US Army 81mm M29 mortar pit, crewed and animated. US-side sibling of mortar_pit_crewed_v1 (NVA/VC). REVISION 2 (2026-08-07 evening): Caleb's direct ruling - 'the sandbags are in the way of the us soldiers running... if you make the mortar pit and the peoples positions the exact same as the NVA itll read fine.' The K=1/0.952 scale-up from revision 1 is GONE. Pit geometry and crew station positions are now numerically identical to mortar_pit_crewed_v1's own local coordinates. REVISION 3 (2026-08-07, later that night): Caleb's correction to the revision-2 finding below - 'i didnt want you to shrink anyone i wanted you to rotate the sandbags and the mortar pit alignment how the nva crew is... you really just need to rotate the sandbags.' He was right. ROOT CAUSE: `us_mortar_pit_sandbags` (and the 8 ammo-round objects) carried `rotation_mode='QUATERNION'` while the euler channel had already been set to match NVA's `1.4992 rad` Z rotation - Blender silently ignores the euler channel when `rotation_mode != 'XYZ'`, so every revision-2 penetration test below was measuring a sandbag mesh still sitting at its ORIGINAL import rotation (effective Z ~3.070 rad / ~176 deg, not the intended ~86 deg), not the NVA-matched one the manifest believed it had applied. Fixed by setting `rotation_mode='XYZ'` and copying NVA's exact euler on `us_mortar_pit_sandbags` and all 8 `us_mortar_round_p0_*/p1_*` objects (the latter had been left at identity rotation entirely, another instance of the same oversight). No rig scale, crew/marker position, or geometry was touched in revision 3 - rotation only, verified below.
packaged_via: bpy.data.libraries.write() from the live session, 2026-08-07 (re-written revision 3 for the sandbag-rotation fix) - no Scene datablock, live .blend untouched. Marker names freed via temporary rename/write/restore around NVA's own station_*/work_mortar* objects, restored and verified immediately after write; parent chains re-checked post-restore.
root_note: root sits at world X=60 in the source scene (clear of the NVA pit at X=29); in the packaged file it is the (0,0,0) origin. ALL local coordinates below are now IDENTICAL to mortar_pit_crewed_v1_manifest.json's own NVA numbers - not scaled, not re-derived.

revision_2_change.what_changed: Dropped the K=1/0.952=1.05042 scale-up entirely, on Caleb's explicit ruling. Rebuilt: (1) a new US_MORTAR_PROPS_SCALE empty at scale 0.952, mirroring NVA_MORTAR_PROPS_SCALE exactly, now parenting the tube/sandbags/crate-root/round-pile - all at NVA's raw (unscaled) local transforms; (2) all 3 crew rig .location/.rotation_euler reset to NVA's raw values, rig .scale left at 1.0 (US native; explicitly NOT reset to 0.952, see measurement below); (3) all 8 markers reset to NVA's raw local_pos; (4) the 3 crew actions' object-level 'location' fcurves (which the mgunner/mdropper/mrunnerAction bake root motion into, not just pose bones) divided by K to undo revision 1's scaling and restore the exact NVA numbers; (5) us_MC_round_slide's location fcurve un-scaled the same way.
revision_2_change.why_the_earlier_scale_up_existed: Revision 1 reasoned that because the M29/sandbag/crate GLBs are real-world-scale assets and NVA's pit uses them at 0.952x to match its shorter crew, the geometrically 'correct' thing for a native-scale (1.0) US crew was to scale the whole composition back up by 1/0.952. That reasoning was sound in isolation but wrong in practice: it moved the sandbag nest 5% further from the pit centre than the runner's approved run path was choreographed for, and the runner's own leg motion (unchanged, since it's the same action) clipped through the corner of the now-relocated sandbag wall. Caleb's ruling supersedes it: match NVA's actual footprint, don't re-derive a 'more correct' one.

penetration_measurements.method: Ray-parity inside-test (BVH tree, ray cast along world +X, odd crossing count = inside) of every vertex of the runner's evaluated, deformed us_grunt_joined/vc_guerilla_joined body mesh against the evaluated sandbag mesh, sampled every 4th frame across the full 288-frame cycle (72 samples). Depth = distance from the inside vertex to the nearest sandbag surface point.
penetration_measurements.(a)_K_scaled_layout_revision_1: WORST PENETRATION: 0.721 m at frame 245 (33 vertices inside). Clipping frames: 17/21/25/29 repeated identically every 72-frame cycle (89/93/97/101, 161/165/169/173, 233/237/241/245) - this is what Caleb saw and flagged.
penetration_measurements.(b)_NVA_identical_position_rig_scale_1.0: WORST PENETRATION: 0.626 m at frame 165 (27 vertices inside). Same repeating frame pattern (17/21/25/29 x4 cycles). STILL CLIPS - matching NVA's raw position numbers alone did not clear it.
penetration_measurements.(c)_NVA_identical_position_rig_scale_0.9: WORST PENETRATION: 0.687 m at frame 101 (33 vertices inside). Slightly WORSE than (b), not better - confirms rig scale (1.0 vs 0.952, a 5% difference) is not the driver of this clip.
penetration_measurements.NVA_reference_own_body_vs_own_sandbags_s: ZERO penetration across the entire 288-frame cycle (0 inside vertices at every one of the 72 sampled frames). This is the decisive number: the approved reference choreography does not clip its own pit at all.
penetration_measurements.diagnosis: Superseded by revision 3 - see (d) below. The (b)/(c) findings were real measurements of a real state, but that state was never the NVA-matched rotation the manifest believed had been applied (see the revision_3 root-cause note in `description`). The 'wider US silhouette' read was a plausible-sounding diagnosis for a penetration that was actually caused by a stale ~176 deg sandbag rotation instead of the intended ~86 deg.
penetration_measurements.(d)_revision_3_rotation_fix: Root cause found and fixed: `us_mortar_pit_sandbags.rotation_mode` was `QUATERNION`, so its already-correct-looking `rotation_euler.z = 1.4992` (matching NVA) was never actually applied - Blender only reads the euler channel when `rotation_mode == 'XYZ'`. The object's real orientation was still its rotation_quaternion value, equivalent to Z ~3.070 rad. Also found and fixed the same way: 8 ammo-round objects (`us_mortar_round_p0_0..3`, `us_mortar_round_p1_0..3`) were left at identity rotation while their NVA counterparts (`mortar_round_p0_0..3`, `mortar_round_p1_0..3`) carry authored tilts. Fix: set `rotation_mode='XYZ'` and copy NVA's exact `rotation_euler` onto all 9 objects. Nothing else touched - no scale, no location, no mesh edit, no crew rig change.
penetration_measurements.(d)_verification_method: Same closest-point-on-mesh + sign-of-dot penetration test (not the ray-parity method used in (a)-(c)), run on the CORRECTED file, EVERY frame of the 288-frame cycle (not sampled) against the runner's evaluated, armature-deformed `us_mortar_runner_us_grunt_joined` mesh vs the evaluated `us_mortar_pit_sandbags` mesh (world-space BVH tree, static per-frame since the sandbag object itself does not animate).
penetration_measurements.(d)_result: ZERO penetration across all 288 frames. 75,744 vertex-samples checked; 0 came within the 30cm proximity band scanned for violations; overall closest approach across the whole cycle was 0.970 m (frame 19). Matches the NVA reference's own 0.0 m / zero-violations result exactly. STATUS: CLEARED.
penetration_measurements.status: CLEARED (revision 3, 2026-08-07). The sandbag (and ammo-round) rotation bug is fixed and verified at 0.0 m worst-case penetration across the full animation cycle, matching the NVA reference. Nothing else in the pit was changed - rig scale, crew/marker positions, and geometry are exactly as revision 2 left them.
